name: Anthropic STT
description: Dictates through the Claude web microphone in your own Chrome window instead of the local model. The window and the Claude session are yours; the plugin only clicks the page's own dictation controls.

settings.label: Transcript poll interval
settings.description: How often the prompt box is read while waiting for the transcript after you stop. Lower reacts sooner; higher is gentler on the browser.

settings.label: Stable reads before accepting
settings.description: How many identical reads in a row count as finished text. Higher avoids grabbing a half-written transcript.

settings.label: Wait between stable reads
settings.description: How long each stability read waits while the text is still changing.

settings.label: Transcript wait after stop
settings.description: How long to wait for the transcript once you stop, before reporting that none arrived. This is not the recording length: Claude ends a dictation by itself after 10 minutes, and the plugin then delivers whatever it captured.

settings.label: Notifications
settings.description: Show a notification when the plugin cannot start or returns an empty transcript.
